description: 10-klatkowa makroprzebitka: czarna stalówka między złotą gwiazdą a pustą kartą portfolio; wizualny most od użycia gwiazdy do opisu twórcy.

prompts.image: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: 10-frame cinematic bridge insert for the vertical AG-Rolka edit. Input images: Image 1 is authoritative continuity for the KKN black textured table, flat heavy gold star, cream portfolio and warm black-gold lighting. Image 2 is authoritative continuity for the same black leather portfolio, blank cream right page and simple matte-black pen with small gold metal details. Do not copy the hands; this new insert contains no hands. Primary request: create a new photorealistic extreme macro composition that visually bridges the physical gold star to writing the creator's description. A simple matte-black fountain pen lies diagonally from lower right toward upper left across the narrow boundary between the cropped gold edge of the star at lower-left and the blank cream portfolio page at upper-right. The polished gold nib sits exactly near the center of frame and carries one small physically plausible distorted reflection of the gold star. The pen does not write; the page remains completely blank. Composition/framing: exact vertical 9:16, intended final size 1080x1920; very tight 85–100mm macro, shallow depth of field; nib and paper edge crisp at center, star recognizable only as a cropped tactile gold edge, black leather portfolio border visible. No hands, no faces, no full star, no wide table view. Lighting/mood: same refined KKN warm gold practical light over a deep black background, prestigious contemporary cinematic realism, restrained highlights, not magical. Materials/textures: real brushed gold nib, matte lacquer pen, fibrous cream paper, stitched black leather, granular gold star edge. Constraints: preserve the visual material language of both references; one pen only; blank paper; physical objects resting naturally; instantly readable during a 10-frame beat insert. Avoid: text, letters, handwriting, UI, logos, KKN emblem, extra pens, hands, people, floating objects, magical glow, sparks, particles, watermark, synthetic product-ad background.
